title.en: The five presets of the home-page demo, from the SDK

goal.en: The dry run on the home page uses five device presets. They are exported to examples/capabilities so the hub, the CLI and every SDK see the same devices; this scenario reproduces the demo for shakshuka.

note.en: The presets carry the vendor name "Cookwala demo presets"; the basic hob robot has one sensor, its camera.
Counter arm: cuts under its camera, cracks the eggs; the person heats and sautes.
Hob robot without thermometers: heating is a logged estimate.
Hob robot with thermometers: heating is verified by the pan thermometer.

Smart oven: it lists cw.op.heat, so the dry run gives it the pan-heating step as an estimate and leaves the rest to the person. The dry run matches operations, not equipment; the recipe's equipment list is a separate check.
Fryer robot: same as the hob robot for this dish, thirteen steps by the device.

outcome.en: You can reproduce any home-page result from code, and you have seen one limit of the dry run worth knowing: it checks operations and sensors, not whether the device owns the pan. Next: scenario 020 checks a temperature trace against an envelope.
